title: A speed control sits in the HUD and works during a run
description: The HUD offers Slow, Normal and Fast, names the active speed starting at Normal, and lets me change speed mid-run without the run ending or the page reloading.

steps.goal: On the Snake game, start a run if one is not already running. Find the speed control in the on-screen HUD — it should offer Slow, Normal and Fast. Click it to change the speed while the run is still going, and watch what happens to the game and to the control itself.
success: A speed control was visible in the HUD, offering Slow, Normal and Fast choices
Using it changed the speed while the run kept going, with no page reload, freeze or error
The control showed which speed was now in effect
